'''Eligyn''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Republic Military/Legends|military]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
{{GameDS}}
In [[3643 BBY]], Eligyn worked alongside [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Rylon (spy)|Rylon]] in a Republic base on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] until it was breached by the [[Empire's Wrath]]. Eligyn and his squad fought against the [[Sith Warrior]], but they were all killed.
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Eligyn is a non-player character from the massively multi-player online role playing game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. He is voiced by [[Maury Sterling]].
